cards.name: Adrenaline Converter
cards.text:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
If a Rival controls at least 2 more Gigs than you, this Unit has {Adrenaline}. (This Unit can attack the turn it's played.)
reminderText: This Unit can attack the turn it's played.

rulings.question: If my Rival controls exactly 2 more Gigs than me when I play Adrenline Converter but I steal a Gig before I attack with the equipped Unit,  does it still have [ADRENALINE]?
rulings.answer: No, the Unit only has [ADRENALINE] while the conditions are met.

cards.name: Arasaka Emergency Radioport
cards.text:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
When this Unit or Legend is spent, you may look at a friendly face-down Legend. If that Legend is ARASAKA or has {Go Solo}, you may Call it for free. (You may only Call a Legend once per turn.)
reminderText: You may only Call a Legend once per turn.

rulings.question: If the equipped Unit or Legend is spent as part of an attack, can Arasaka Emergency Radioport Call a Legend before that Unit’s [ATTACK] effect resolves?

cards.name: Deadman Transmitter
cards.text:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
If this Unit would be defeated, defeat its "DEADMAN TRANSMITTER" instead.

rulings.question: If a Unit or Legend with two or more Deadman Transmitters is defeated, do I have to defeat both Deadman Transmitters?
If Deadman Transmitter protects a Unit from being defeated in a fight did that Unit still lose the fight?

cards.name: Dying Night
cards.subtitle: V's Pistol
cards.text:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
{Attack} Decrease a Gig by up to 2. At the end of your turn, if this Unit is named "V", ready 2 Eddies.

rulings.question: If I choose not to decrease a Gig, can I still ready 2 Eddies at the end of my turn if the equipped Unit is named "V"?
If this Gear is attached to a Unit named "V" and the Unit attacks but is defeated before the end of the turn, can I still ready 2 Eddies?

cards.name: Gorilla Arms
cards.text:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
The first time this Unit steals 1 or more Gigs each turn, steal a rival Gig with a value not shared by a friendly Gig.

rulings.question: Who steals the Gig with this effect; the player, or the Unit equipped with Gorilla arms?

cards.name: Kiroshi Optics
cards.text:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
{Attack} Look at a friendly face-down Legend. (Don't reveal it.)

rulings.question: Do I have to look at at friendly face-down Legend even if I don't want to?

cards.name: Mandibular Upgrade
cards.text:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
{Blocker} (You may spend this Unit to redirect a rival Unit's attack to it instead.)

cards.name: Mantis Blades
cards.text:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
"One cut, one kill."

cards.name: NetWatch Netdriver
cards.text:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
When this Unit or Legend is spent, draw 1.

rulings.question: When I spend a Unit equipped with Netwatch Netdriver to declare an attack, do I get Netwatch Netdriver's effect before or after I resolve the attack?
If I spend a Unit equipped with Netwatch Netdriver to declare an attack, and the Unit or Legend has an [ATTACK] effect, do I get Netwatch Netdriver's effect before or after the [ATTACK] effect?
rulings.answer: You can choose the order you resolve these effects.

rulings.question: If I spend a Unit or Legend equipped with Netwatch Netdriver to activate the Unit/Legend's [Spend Icon:] effect, do I resolve Netwatch Netdriver's effect before or after the activated effect?
rulings.answer: After. Resolve the activated [Spend Icon:] effect first.

rulings.question: If I spend a Legend equipped with Netwatch Netdriver to pay a card's cost, do I resolve Netwatch Netdriver's effect before or after I play the card?

cards.name: Overwatch
cards.subtitle: Panam's Gift
cards.text: {Quick} 1 €$, {Spend} Discard 1. Defeat a spent rival Unit with cost equal to or less than the discarded card's cost.

rulings.question: If I use this card's [Spend Icon:] effect but my hand is empty, can I still do the rest of the effect?

cards.name: Riot Shield
cards.text:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
{Blocker} (You may spend this Unit to redirect a rival Unit's attack to it instead.)
Rivals must pay +2 €$ to use {Go Solo}.

rulings.question: Does this effect force my Rival to use [GO SOLO] on their turn if they have enough €$ available?

cards.name: Sandevistan
cards.text:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
At the end of your turn, ready this Unit or Legend.

rulings.question: At the end of my turn do I have to ready this Unit or Legend even if I don't want to?

cards.name: Satori
cards.subtitle: Sword of Saburo
cards.text:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
When this Unit wins a fight against a rival Unit, draw 1.

rulings.question: If a friendly Unit equipped with Satori fights a Unit of the same power and they defeat each other, do I still draw 1?
If my Unit equipped with Satori is attacked by a rival Unit and my Unit wins the fight, do I draw 1?

cards.name: Tetratronic Rippler
cards.text:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
When this Unit or Legend is spent, search the top card of your deck. You may trash it. (Otherwise, keep it on the top of your deck.)
reminderText: Otherwise, keep it on the top of your deck.

rulings.question: When searching the top card of the deck is the card still currently counted as being in the deck?

cards.name: The Relic
cards.subtitle: Experimental Biochip
cards.text: {Defeated} Play another Unit with cost 9 or less from your trash for free. Then, bottom-deck this Unit.

rulings.question: When a Unit or Legend equipped with The Relic is defeated, do I move any equipped Gear on it to the bottom-deck, too?
rulings.answer: No. The Unit/Legend moves to the trash first, so any Gear (including The Relic) remains in the trash when you bottom-deck the Unit/Legend.

cards.name: Zetatech Berserk
cards.text: Play this Gear for -1 €$ for each friendly face-up Legend, to a minimum of 1 €$.

rulings.question: Does this card's effect change the cost of the card?
rulings.answer: No, only the amount you pay.

cards.name: Zetatech Faceplate
cards.text:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
When this Unit or Legend is spent, adjust a Gig by up to 1. Then, if you control 3 or more Gigs with different values, draw 1.

rulings.question: When I spend a Unit equipped with Zetatech Faceplate to declare an attack, do I get Zetatech Faceplate's effect before or after I resolve the attack?
rulings.answer: Before. Adjust the Gig for Zetatech Faceplate's effect before moving on to your Rival's react step.

rulings.question: If I spend a Unit equipped with Zetatech Faceplate to declare an attack, and the Unit or Legend has an [ATTACK] effect, do I get Zetatech Faceplacte's effect before or after the [ATTACK] effect?
rulings.answer: You can choose the order you resolve these effects.

rulings.question: If I spend a Unit or Legend equipped with Zetatech Faceplate to activate the Unit/Legend's [Spend Icon:] effect, do I get Zetatech Faceplate's effect before or after the activated effect?
rulings.answer: After. Resolve the activated [Spend Icon:] effect first.

rulings.question: If I spend a Legend equipped with Zetatech Faceplate to pay a card's cost, do I get Zetatech Faceplate's effect before or after I play the card?
rulings.answer: After. Play the card first, then adjust the Gig.

cards.name: Adam Smasher
cards.subtitle: Ender of Legends
cards.text:
{Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.)
{Play} Defeat a rival Unit.

rulings.question: Does Adam Smasher’s [PLAY] effect trigger when he is called or flipped face-up as a Legend?
rulings.answer: No, the [PLAY] effect only activates when you play Adam Smasher to the field area.

rulings.question: Does Adam Smasher’s [PLAY] effect trigger when he Goes Solo?
rulings.answer: Yes. [GO SOLO] plays Adam Smasher to the field area and triggers the [PLAY] effect.

rulings.question: If Adam Smasher is removed from the field area after being played to the field area is Adam Smasher removed from the game instead of being placed in the designated area?
If Adam Smasher’s cost is reduced does that also reduce cost to activate [GO SOLO]?

cards.name: Alt Cunningham
cards.subtitle: Soulkiller Architect
cards.text:
{Spend} Your next Program this turn plays for -1 €$ for each friendly min Gig, to a minimum of 1 €$.
1 €$, {Spend} Play a Program from your trash. Bottom-deck it after you play it. (You still pay its cost.)

rulings.question: Does Alt Cunningham's first effect apply to Programs played from Trash, too?
If I ready Alt Cunningham after using her first effect and use it again before playing a Program, does the discount stack?
I activated Alt Cunningham's first effect with 2 friendly min Gigs, but before I play my next Program I acquire a 3rd min Gig. Does my next Program play for -3 €$ instead of -2€$?
rulings.answer: No, the reduction amount is determined when you activate the effect.

cards.name: Dexter DeShawn
cards.subtitle: Off the Grid
cards.text:
{Call} Choose one effect.
Give a friendly Unit +2 power this turn. // Draw 1.
{Spend}: Increase a Gig by up to 2.

rulings.question: If I don't have a friendly Unit on the field when I call Dexter Deshawn, do I have to choose Draw 1?
rulings.answer: No, you can still choose the other effect, it just fails.

rulings.question: If I call Dexter Deshawn as a reaction, can I play a [QUICK] card that I drew off of Dexter's effect?
Can Dexter Deshawn ’s [Spend Icon:] effect increase either a friendly Gig or a rival Gig?

cards.name: Dum Dum
cards.subtitle: Maelstrom Triggerman
cards.text:
{Call} You may defeat a friendly Gear. If you do, draw 2. Otherwise, draw 1.
{Quick} 1 €$, {Spend} Give a friendly Unit +1 power this turn for each of its equipped Gear.

rulings.question: Can Dum Dum’s [QUICK] effect choose a friendly Unit with no equipped Gear?
If the chosen Unit gains or loses Gear after Dum Dum’s [QUICK] effect resolves, does the power bonus change?

cards.name: Evelyn Parker
cards.subtitle: Beautiful Enigma
cards.text:
When a friendly CORPO or GANGER Unit steals 1 or more Gigs, ready 1 Eddie.
1 €$, {Spend} A rival Unit must attack next turn if it can.

rulings.question: If a rival Unit chosen by Evenlyn Parker's second effect makes an attack and then readies in the same turn, is it forced to make another attack?
rulings.answer: Yes; as long as the chosen Unit can attack, your Rival cannot end their turn until it attacks.

rulings.question: If I have a Unit chosen by Evelyn Parker's second effect, do I have to attack with it as soon as possible, or can I play other cards first?
rulings.answer: You may do other actions but cannot end your turn if the Unit chosen by Evelyn Parker can still legally declare an attack.

cards.name: Goro Takemura
cards.subtitle: Hands Unclean
cards.text:
{Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.)
{Blocker} (You may spend this Unit to redirect a rival Unit's attack to it instead.)

rulings.question: Can I use this Legend's [Blocker] in the Legend area?

cards.name: Goro Takemura
cards.subtitle: Vengeful Bodyguard
cards.text:
{Quick} 1 €$, {Spend} Give a friendly Unit with cost 4 or less {Blocker} this turn. If you control a value-pair of Gigs, also give it +1 power this turn.
When a friendly Unit uses {Blocker}, you may discard 1. If you do, draw 1.

rulings.question: If I manage to play a Unit during my React step and I give it [BLOCKER] from Goro Takemura, can that friendly Unit use [BLOCKER] immediately?
When a friendly Unit uses [BLOCKER] am I forced to discard 1?
If I have no cards in deck may I still discard 1?
rulings.answer: Yes, but you must draw 1 after, so you will lose the game.

rulings.question: Does a friendly Unit using [BLOCKER] trigger Goro Takemura's second effect even if it's not a result of first effect?

cards.name: Hanako Arasaka
cards.subtitle: Daughter of the Emperor
cards.displayName: Hanako Arasaka: Daughter of the Emperor
cards.text:
{Spend} Swap a friendly Gig with a rival Gig.
At the start of your turn, draw 1 for each friendly value-pair of Gigs.

rulings.question: If either myself or my Rival controls 0 Gigs, can I swap?
Is swapping Gigs considered stealing?
When I activate this effect, do I get to choose the rival Gig too?
rulings.answer: Yes, you choose both Gigs involved in the swap.

cards.name: Jackie Welles
cards.subtitle: Mama's Favorite
cards.text:
{Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.)
If a friendly Unit would be defeated, you may spend 1 €$ to defeat this Legend instead. (Remove it from the game.)

rulings.question: When I defeat Jackie Welles instead of a friendly Unit, does the Unit's [DEFEATED] effect trigger?
Can I use this effect if Jackie Welles is in the Field area as a Unit?
Can I use this effect if Jackie Welles is in the Legends area?
If Jackie Welles would be defeated while it's a Unit, could I use Jackie Welle's effect to defeat himself instead of being defeated the other way?

cards.name: Jackie Welles
cards.subtitle: Pour One Out For Me
cards.displayName: Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me
cards.text: The first time you play a Blue Unit or Blue Gear each turn, you may decrease a friendly Gig by up to 2. If it becomes a min Gig, draw 1.

rulings.question: If I've already played a Blue Unit or Gear this turn before Jackie Welles is face-up, then flip Jackie, can I trigger Jackie's effect that turn by playing another Blue Gear or Unit?
Does playing a Legend from the Legends area to the field, trigger Jackie Welles's effect?
If I choose an already min Gig for Jackie Welles's effect, can I draw 1?

cards.name: Johnny Silverhand
cards.subtitle: Rocking Renegade
cards.text: 2 €$, {Spend} A friendly Unit can attack spent rival Units the turn it's played. If it's a ROCKER Unit, also give it +2 power this turn. This effect costs -1 €$ for each friendly Gig with 8+ value.

rulings.question: Can I reduce Johnny Silverhand’s effect cost to 0 €$?
rulings.answer: Yes, but you still need to spend Johnny Silverhand to activate it.

rulings.question: Can I use Johnny's effect on a Unit that wasn't played this turn?
Can a Unit played on a previous turn still attack the rival Gig area if I use Johnny's effect on it?

cards.name: Judy Álvarez
cards.subtitle: Braindance Maestro
cards.text:
When you play a BRAINDANCE Program, give a friendly Unit +1 power this turn.
{Spend} Trash the top card of your deck. If it's a Program, you may add it to your hand.

rulings.question: If I play a Program from my trash, does the first effect still trigger?
Can I trigger the first effect multiple times in a turn by playing multiple BRAINDANCE Programs?
Can I choose the same friendly Unit with this card's first effect each time I play a Program?
If I play a [QUICK] BRAINDANCE Program as a reaction on my Rival's turn, does first effect trigger?

cards.name: Kerry Eurodyne
cards.subtitle: Axe, Attitude, Audience
cards.text:
When you roll in a Gig from your fixer area, you may ignore the result and reroll it once.
When you roll a min or max value on a Gig, draw 1. If it's a d20, draw 3 instead.

rulings.question: If I roll a 1 on a friendly Gig and choose to reroll with Kerry Eurodyne's effect, but don't roll a 1 or 20 on that Gig, do I still get the draw effect for the first result?

cards.name: Muamar Reyes
cards.subtitle: El Capitán
cards.text:
{Call} Choose one effect.
A friendly Unit can't be defeated in a fight this turn. // Draw 1.
{Spend} Adjust a Gig by 1.

rulings.question: If I do not have a friendly Unit, do I have to choose the Draw 1 effect?
rulings.answer: No. You can still "choose" the other effect, it just fails.

rulings.question: Does Muamar Reyes's effect each fight the Unit is in this turn?
If the chosen Unit with Muamar Reye's effect can't be defeated, can it still lose a fight?

cards.name: Padre
cards.subtitle: Man of the Cross
cards.text:
{Call} Choose one effect.
Spend a rival Unit. // Draw 1.
{Spend} Set a player's Gig to the same value as another player's Gig.

rulings.question: If there are no viable rival Units, do I have to choose the draw effect?
rulings.answer: No. You can still "choose" the other effect, it just fails.

rulings.question: May I use this card's [Spend Icon:] if all Gigs are already the same value?

cards.name: Panam Palmer
cards.subtitle: Nomad Cavalry
cards.text:
2 €$, {Spend} Move a Gear from this Legend to an unequipped friendly Unit. If you do, ready that Unit.
At the end of your turn, if 5 or more friendly Units and/or Legends are equipped, ready them.

rulings.question: Can I move a Gear from this Legend to an unequipped friendly Unit that's already ready?
For the second effect,  do I need both Units and Legends equipped?
rulings.answer: No, a combination of any 5 equipped Units and equipped Legends satisfies the condition.

cards.name: River Ward
cards.subtitle: Detective on the Hunt
cards.displayName: River Ward: Detective on the Hunt
cards.text:
{Quick} {Spend} Play a Gear with cost 2 or less from your hand for free.
When a friendly equipped Unit is defeated, search the top 2 cards of your deck and trash 1.

rulings.question: Can I activate River Ward’s [QUICK] [Spend Icon:] effect if I have no Gear cards in hand?
Does the Gear have to be equipped to this Legend?
Do you have to Trash the top card after searching?
Do I keep the card not Trashed on top of my deck?

cards.name: Rogue Amendiares
cards.subtitle: Preem Solo
cards.text:
{Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.)
When a friendly Legend steals a Gig, if its value is even, draw 1. If its value is odd, a Rival discards 1.

rulings.question: Does Rogue Amendiares' effect trigger if she steals a Gig herself?
Does Rogue Amendiares' effect work while face-up in the Legend area?

cards.name: Royce
cards.subtitle: Psycho on the Edge
cards.text:
{Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.)
During your turn, this Legend has +2 power for each of its equipped Gear.

rulings.question: Can I equip Gear to Royce in the Legends area?
rulings.answer: Yes, you can equip face-up Legends in the Legends area.

rulings.question: Does the Royce +2 power for each equipped Gear apply while he is still in the Legend area?
What happens to a Gear on a Legend when the Legend is removed from play?
rulings.answer: When a Legend leaves the field or Legends area, its attached Gear follows the Legend to that area, then is no longer equipped in the new area. So, the Gear remains in that new area when you remove the Legend from play.

cards.name: Saburo Arasaka
cards.subtitle: Stubborn Patriarch
cards.text:
Friendly ARASAKA Units have +1 power while attacking.
(Units steal an extra Gig for every 10 power.)
reminderText: Units steal an extra Gig for every 10 power.

rulings.question: Do my Friendly Arasaka Units have +1 power while in the fight or steal step?

cards.name: Sasha Yakovleva
cards.subtitle: Won't Let You Down
cards.displayName: Sasha Yakovleva: Won't Let You Down

rulings.question: If I attack the rival Gig area with Sasha but she has 0 power, does she steal a Gig?
When I declare an attack with Sasha Yakovleva, can I use her [ATTACK] effect before I choose a target?
rulings.answer: No. You must declare the attack target before revealing the card for her [ATTACK] effect.

cards.name: V
cards.subtitle: Corporate Exile
cards.text: {Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. When it leaves the field, remove it from the game.)

rulings.question: Can I play this Legend to the Field area without using the [GO SOLO] keyword?

cards.name: V
cards.subtitle: Streetkid
cards.text:
{Call} Trash 3. Then, add 1 BRAINDANCE Program from your trash to your hand.
{Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.)

rulings.question: When I trash 3, do I need to add a BRAINDANCE Program from the cards I trashed?
rulings.answer: No. You can add any BRAINDANCE Program from your trash.

rulings.question: If there are fewer than 3 cards in my deck, can I still call V?
rulings.answer: Yes. Trash as many cards as possible, instead.

rulings.question: If V’s [CALL] effect trashes multiple BRAINDANCE Programs,  can I choose more than 1?

cards.name: Viktor Vektor
cards.subtitle: Sit Down and Relax
cards.displayName: Viktor Vektor: Sit Down and Relax
cards.text: {Call} Search the top 5 cards of your deck. Reveal up to 2 Gears with cost 2 or less and add them to your hand. Bottom-deck the rest in a random order.

rulings.question: When I search the top 5 cards of my deck, can I choose not to reveal any cards and bottom-deck them all even if there's a viable Gear among them?

cards.name: Wakako Okada
cards.subtitle: Peace and Harmony
cards.text:
{Call} Choose one effect.
Give a rival Unit -2 power this turn. // Draw 1.
{Spend}: Decrease a Gig by up to 2.

rulings.question: If there are no viable rival Units, do I have to choose the draw effect?
rulings.answer: No. You can still "choose" the other effect, it just fails.

rulings.question: Can I use this card's [Spend Icon:] effect on an already min Gig?

cards.name: Yorinobu Arasaka
cards.subtitle: Embracing Destruction
cards.text: The first time a friendly ARASAKA Unit attacks each turn, draw 1. Then, if you have less than 20 ☆ (Street Cred), discard 1.

rulings.question: If I've already attacked with an ARASAKA Unit this turn before Yorinobu Arasaka is face-up, then flip Yorinobu, can I trigger Yorinobu's effect that turn by attacking with another ARASAKA Unit?

cards.name: (Don't Fear) The Reaper
cards.text: Spend all rival Units. Then, defeat a spent Unit.

rulings.question: If all rival Units are already spent, can I still use this card?
Can I defeat a spent Unit that I did not spend with this effect?

cards.name: Afterparty at Lizzie's
cards.text: Adjust a Gig by up to 1. If you control 2 or more Gigs with different values, draw 1.

rulings.question: If I choose not to adjust a Gig, can I still draw 1 if I control 2 or more Gigs with different values?

cards.name: All is Lost
cards.text: Trash 3. Add a Unit from among them to your hand.

rulings.question: If All is Lost trashes one or more Units, do I have to add them to my hand  even if I don't want to?
If All is Lost's effect trashes no Units, can I still add a Unit to my hand?
If I have fewer than 3 cards in my deck, can I still play All is Lost?
rulings.answer: Yes. Trash as many cards as possible, instead.

cards.name: Appetite for Destruction
cards.text: The next time a friendly Unit wins a fight by 3+ power this turn, it also steals a Gig.

rulings.question: When I play Appetite for Destruction, do I choose a friendly Unit, or can any friendly Unit satisfy the effect later this turn?
rulings.answer: You must choose a friendly Unit when you play this card. The condition will only be met when that Unit wins a fight.

rulings.question: If a Unit steals a Gig because of Appetite for Destruction, does that count as that Unit stealing a Gig for effects that trigger when that Unit steals a Gig?
If the friendly Unit cannot defeat the rival Unit but still wins the fight, does it still steal a Gig?

cards.name: Bonnie and Clyde
cards.text: Defeat a rival Unit with power 4 or less. You may defeat 2 instead if a Rival controls at least 2 Gigs more than you.

rulings.question: If a Rival controls at least 2 more Gigs than me, can I still choose to defeat only one Unit?

cards.name: Bootleg Black Sapphire Show
cards.text:
Sell the top card of your deck.
If you control a Gig with an even value and a Gig with an odd value, draw 2.

rulings.question: Do I reveal or get to look at the card I am selling?
If the top card of my deck doesn't have a sell tag, do I still sell it for this effect?
If I already sold a card during my main phase, can I still sell a card from Bootleg Sapphire's effect?

cards.name: Carnage at the Colosseum
cards.text:
Play this Program for -1 €$ for each friendly Gig with 8+ value, to a minimum of 1 €$.
Defeat a rival Unit with less power than a friendly Unit.

rulings.question: When I play this Program for less because of it's effect does that change the cost of the card too?

cards.name: Chrome Reverie
cards.text: A rival Unit can't attack until your next turn. If you control a min Gig, you may Call a Legend for free. (You can only Call a Legend once per turn.)
reminderText: You can only Call a Legend once per turn.

rulings.question: If I the chosen rival Unit that can't attack until my next turn is given the effect to attack. Can it?
What is a min Gig?
When resolving this effect and do not choose to Call a Legend for free. Can I call a Legend for free later in the turn from this effect?

cards.name: Corporate Surveillance
cards.text: Spend a rival Unit with cost 4 or less.

rulings.question: Can I play this card without a rival Unit on the field?
Can I choose a Unit that's already spent for this card's effect?

cards.name: Cyberpsychosis
cards.text: {Quick} Give an equipped Unit +3 power this turn for each of its equipped Gears. If that Unit steals or fights, defeat it at the end of this turn.

rulings.question: Can I choose an equipped rival Unit with this effect?
If I play this Program [QUICK] as a reaction and choose the attacking rival Unit for the effect, what happens?
rulings.answer: The rival Unit gets the power boost for the ensuing fight and is defeated at the end of the turn.

rulings.question: If a Unit  under the effect of Cyberpsychosis attacks but does not make it to the Fight or Steal step, is it still defeated at the end of the turn?

cards.name: Detonate
cards.text: {Quick} Defeat a rival Gear with power 2 or less.

rulings.question: Can Detonate defeat Gear equipped to a face-up Legend?
Can I play Detonate if there are no rival Gears in play?

cards.name: Floor It
cards.text: {Quick} Give a rival Unit -1 power this turn. Draw 1.

rulings.question: Can you play this with no rival Units in play?

cards.name: Fool on the Hill
cards.text: Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. A Rival chooses whether you add them to your hand or trash them. If you trash them, draw 2.

rulings.question: When I reveal the top 2 cards of my deck, are they still considered part of my deck?

cards.name: Gunpoint Diplomacy
cards.text:
Give a friendly Unit these effects. If you have less ☆ (Street Cred) than a Rival, they instead choose one effect for you.
The next time this Unit attacks this turn, it may attack ready Units. // Give this Unit +3 power this turn.

rulings.question: Can I choose the order of the two effects?
rulings.answer: No. You must resolve the effect from top to bottom.

rulings.question: When my Rival chooses the effect for Gunpoint Diplomacy, do they also choose the friendly Unit?

cards.name: Industrial Assembly
cards.text: Increase a Gig by up to 4. If you control a Gig with 8+ value, draw 1.

rulings.question: Can I choose to increase a Gig by 0?
rulings.answer: Yes, but it does not count as "adjusting" a Gig for effects triggered by "adjusting a Gig."

rulings.question: Can I adjust a rival Gig?

cards.name: Les Élémens
cards.text: Bottom-deck a Rival's lowest-power Unit. (If there are multiple, choose 1.)

rulings.question: Who chooses?
rulings.answer: The Player activating the card Chooses.

rulings.question: If I give a friendly Unit [ADRENALINE] on my Rival's turn, can it make an attack?

cards.name: Viktor Vektor
cards.subtitle: Drop Your Illusions
cards.text: Play your first CYBERWARE Gear each turn for -3 €$, to a minimum of 1 €$.

rulings.question: If I have a way to play a Gear on my rival's turn, do I still get the  -3 €$ discount?
When I play my first Cyberware each turn, do I have to pay the reduced amount even if I would prefer to pay full price?

cards.name: Viktor Vektor
cards.subtitle: You Might Feel a Little Pinch
cards.displayName: Viktor Vektor: You Might Feel a Little Pinch
cards.text: {Play} Play a CYBERWARE Gear with cost 2 or less from your trash for free. Equip it only to another friendly Unit.

rulings.question: Can I choose not to use Viktor Vektor's [PLAY] effect?
rulings.answer: No, the effect is mandatory. If you can do it, you must.

cards.name: Westbrook Netrunner
cards.text: {Play} Until your next turn, rival Legends can't steal friendly Gigs with value less than their power.

rulings.question: If my Rival plays a Legend to the field after I play Westbrook Netrunner, can the Legend steal a Gig with value less than their power?
If Westbrook Netrunner is defeated before my next turn, is its effect still active?

cards.name: Wraith Marauders
cards.text: When this Unit steals a Gig, ready another friendly Unit with power equal to the Gig's value.

rulings.question: When this card steals a Gig do I have to ready another friendly Unit even if I don't want to?

cards.name: Yorinobu Arasaka
cards.subtitle: Steel Dragon
cards.text:
{Play} You may play a Unit with cost 4 or less from your hand or trash for free. It can attack rival Units this turn.
The first time an ARASAKA Unit is defeated each turn, draw 1.

rulings.question: If the Unit played by Yorinobu has [ADRENALINE], can it attack the rival Gig area this turn?
Does Yorinobu count itself for “the first time an ARASAKA Unit is defeated each turn”?
If a friendly Arasaka Unit was defeated previusly during my turn and then play Yorinobu Arasaka. If another friendly Arasaka Unit is then defeated this turn. Will I draw 1 off Yorinobu's effect?
